parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Make sure that the client token is unique for each request. The token can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length and is case-sensitive.

parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) cluster.

> Call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query the IDs of all Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) clusters in the destination region.

parameters.name: PoolName
parameters.description: The name of the resource group.
